messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PROD alert — inference.streaming.p99 > 2.5s in us-west-2 (started 09:12 UTC). Paging oncall.
Raj (oncall): I'm on it, picking up triage. first look: p95 ~ 600ms, p99 trending toward 3s, spikes correlate with streaming stalls.
Amy R: seeing lots of small batches backed up in the router, long tail on token generation.
Sophie: are we seeing errors from control-plane deps? configfetch/auth?
Raj (oncall): yes — config-fetch 5xx and auth 429 bursts in logs. quick tail: `service=config-fetch status=503 count=214` in last 5m.
Elaine: DB pool logs show exhausted connections on the configstore read replicas around same time. Possibly a hotkey on a new feature flag rollout.
Mike: +1, we rolled new ff yesterday to 10% — could be thundering herd on metadata.
Ben (CS): any customer impact? A few support tickets: streaming timeouts on longer responses, some customers see partial responses. Marking P1 for customer-facing impact.
Sophie: let's list mitigations: 1) pause feature flag rollout 2) enable cached config fallback 3) throttle config-fetch calls from runtime 4) increase connection pool temporarily 5) route traffic to other regions if capacity allows.
Raj (oncall): executing now: pausing rollout (Elaine, can you confirm FF rollback?), enabling cached fallback (Amy), and adding circuit-breaker to config fetch (Sophie).
Elaine: pausing rollout now — `kubectl patch featureflag/new-dialog -p '{"spec":{"rollout":0}}'` — confirmed.
Amy R: enabling cached fallback — flipping `use_config_cache=true` in runtime config and pushing a quick canary — applying patch in prod cluster.
Mike: increasing DB pool on configstore replicas by +20 connections via terraform apply (will take ~2m). kicking off now.
InfraBot: Terraform apply started for module=cfg-db-pool increase by 20 connections (plan ok).
Raj (oncall): adding short-term rate-limiter on config fetch paths: `X-Config-Fetch: 50r/s per service` — Soph will deploy a sidecar rule.
Sophie: sidecar rule deployed, enabling CB with 5s timeout and 50r/s burst.
Amy R: after cache fallback enabled, we see reduction in config fetch 5xx and auth 429s. p99 dropping from ~3s -> ~1.4s. streaming stalls still occasional but much better.
Raj (oncall): good. still seeing 502/503 from a small set of hosts — listing: cfg-store-7, cfg-store-9. Elaine can we cordon?
Elaine: draining cfg-store-7 now, cfg-store-9 flagged for maintenance, moving traffic off.
Mike: DB replica scaling finished; connections freed up.
Ben (CS): customers on call reported improvement after 09:21 UTC, reduced error rates on their side.
Raj (oncall): status update for execs: mitigation in place (cache fallback, FF rollback, CB + rate-limits, DB pool bump, cordoned unhealthy replicas). p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.2s. severity lowered to P2 (customer impact reduced).
Amy R: quick diagnostic commands I ran:
```
# check recent 5xx from config fetch
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=config-fetch --since=10m | grep "status=5.." | wc -l

# curl health
curl -sS https://runtime-usw2.internal/health | jq .latency_p99
```
Raj (oncall): also ran a query to find slow queries hitting the config DB:
```
SELECT query, count(*) as cnt, avg(total_time) as avg_ms
FROM pg_stat_statements
WHERE query LIKE '%feature_flags%'
GROUP BY query
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Sophie: found one hot query doing full-table scan on flags when `env=NULL` — patching to add index on (env, flag_key).
Elaine: creating a maintenance ticket to rebuild the replica `cfg-store-9` and check for I/O issues.
Mike: follow-ups: add circuit-breaker metric to dashboards, increase alert sensitivity for configstore 5xx, add automated fallback to cached config in runtime with gradual ramp-down.
Ben (CS): prepping customer comms: acknowledging incident, describing mitigations, ETA for RCA. Will send out interim note confirming reduced impact.
Raj (oncall): handing off to SRE for post-incident: Sophie and Mike, please take ownership of long-term fixes and RCA. I'll remain on standby for any regressions.
Sophie: taking handoff. creating incident board now and will schedule 1h postmortem.
Mike: will own infra changes (DB indexing + replica rebuild) and make pool scaling automated.
Amy R: will add more aggressive local config caching and fallback tests to CI.
Elaine: I'll follow up with rollout guard enhancements so feature flags don't cause metadata storms.
Raj (oncall): timeline notes:
- 09:12 UTC alert triggered
- 09:14 initial triage: configfetch 5xx + auth 429s observed
- 09:16 paused FF rollout + enabled cache fallback + rate limit/cb deployed
- 09:21 DB pool increase + cordon unhealthy replicas
- 09:25 p99 reduced to ~1.2s, customer reports improvement
- 09:40 severity downgraded to P2; handing off to SRE team for RCA

Raj (oncall): action items (owners):
- Sophie: create postmortem, add dashboard panels for configstore 5xx and CB tripping (due EOD)
- Mike: rebuild cfg-store-9, add index on flags, automate pool scaling (due 48h)
- Amy R: improve runtime cached fallback and add integration test (due 72h)
- Elaine: rollout guard + FF telemetry to detect hotkeys (due 7 days)
- Ben (CS): send interim customer note and schedule follow-up comms (ASAP)

IncidentBot: Incident marked resolved for now — handlers: Raj (oncall), Sophie (SRE). Please add postmortem link when ready.
Ben (CS): drafting message now, will post update to affected customers in 15m.
Sophie: starting the postmortem doc and will ping for evidence. Thanks all — nice quick coord. :thumbsup:
Raj (oncall): thanks team — closing oncall loop, will remain reachable if anything pops.
Elaine: noted. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
